question: Which actors are represented in the emergency-prescription environment?
query: PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX reo: <http://re-environment-onto.org/ontology#> SELECT DISTINCT ?actor WHERE { ?actor rdf:type ?t . ?t rdfs:subClassOf* reo:Actor . } ORDER BY ?actor

question: What authority level is asserted for the Physician?
query: PREFIX reo: <http://re-environment-onto.org/ontology#> PREFIX ex: <http://hospital.example.org#> SELECT ?authority WHERE { ex:Physician reo:authorityLevel ?authority . }

question: Which actors are stakeholders of G005?
query: PREFIX reo: <http://re-environment-onto.org/ontology#> PREFIX ex: <http://hospital.example.org#> SELECT ?actor WHERE { ex:G005 reo:hasStakeholder ?actor . } ORDER BY ?actor

question: Does the goal-refinement graph contain a cycle?
query: PREFIX reo: <http://re-environment-onto.org/ontology#> ASK { ?g reo:refines+ ?g . }

question: Which domain properties belong to Medication?
query: PREFIX reo: <http://re-environment-onto.org/ontology#> PREFIX ex: <http://hospital.example.org#> SELECT ?property WHERE { ex:D001_Medication reo:hasProperty ?property . } ORDER BY ?property

question: Which hard constraints explicitly apply to the Physician?
query: PREFIX reo: <http://re-environment-onto.org/ontology#> PREFIX ex: <http://hospital.example.org#> SELECT ?constraint WHERE { ?constraint reo:appliesTo ex:Physician ; reo:enforcementLevel "hard" . } ORDER BY ?constraint

question: Is the Emergency Department declared as an exception to the HIPAA constraint?
query: PREFIX reo: <http://re-environment-onto.org/ontology#> PREFIX ex: <http://hospital.example.org#> ASK { ex:C001_HIPAA reo:hasException ex:X001_EmergencyDept . }

question: Which constraints are explicitly active in the Emergency Department context?
query: PREFIX reo: <http://re-environment-onto.org/ontology#> PREFIX ex: <http://hospital.example.org#> SELECT ?constraint WHERE { ex:X001_EmergencyDept reo:hasActiveConstraint ?constraint . } ORDER BY ?constraint

question: Which actors are active in the Emergency Department context?
query: PREFIX reo: <http://re-environment-onto.org/ontology#> PREFIX ex: <http://hospital.example.org#> SELECT ?actor WHERE { ex:X001_EmergencyDept reo:hasActiveActor ?actor . } ORDER BY ?actor

question: Which unresolved uncertainty blocks G002?
query: PREFIX reo: <http://re-environment-onto.org/ontology#> PREFIX ex: <http://hospital.example.org#> SELECT ?uncertainty WHERE { ?uncertainty reo:status "unvalidated" ; reo:blocks ex:G002 . } ORDER BY ?uncertainty

question: Is there any goal-blocking uncertainty without a validation plan?
query: PREFIX reo: <http://re-environment-onto.org/ontology#> ASK { ?u reo:blocks ?g . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?u reo:validationPlan ?plan . } }

question: What are the source and target of the Physician-to-EHR interaction?
query: PREFIX reo: <http://re-environment-onto.org/ontology#> PREFIX ex: <http://hospital.example.org#> SELECT ?source ?target WHERE { ex:I001_PhysicianToEHR reo:hasSource ?source ; reo:hasTarget ?target . }

question: Which domain concept is exchanged by I001?
query: PREFIX reo: <http://re-environment-onto.org/ontology#> PREFIX ex: <http://hospital.example.org#> SELECT ?data WHERE { ex:I001_PhysicianToEHR reo:exchangesData ?data . }

question: Is there any interaction in the fixture without a source or target?
query: PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX reo: <http://re-environment-onto.org/ontology#> ASK { ?i rdf:type ?t . ?t rdfs:subClassOf* reo:Interaction . FILTER (NOT EXISTS { ?i reo:hasSource ?s . } || NOT EXISTS { ?i reo:hasTarget ?tgt . }) }

question: Is there any explicitly typed RegulatoryConstraint without authoritative text?
query: PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX reo: <http://re-environment-onto.org/ontology#> ASK { ?c rdf:type reo:RegulatoryConstraint . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?c reo:hasAuthoritativeText ?text . } }

question: Which constraints are applicable to R001 through any applicability route (declared, active in its context, governing its actor or interaction, or applying to one of its references)?
query: PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX reo: <http://re-environment-onto.org/ontology#> PREFIX ex: <http://hospital.example.org#> PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#> SELECT DISTINCT ?c WHERE { BIND(<http://hospital.example.org/requirements#R001> AS ?r) { ?r reo:declaresHardConstraint ?c } UNION { ?r reo:assessedInContext ?x . ?x reo:hasActiveConstraint ?c } UNION { ?r reo:hasResponsibleActor ?a . ?a reo:isSubjectTo ?c } UNION { ?r reo:usesInteraction ?i . ?i reo:governedBy ?c } UNION { ?r (reo:hasResponsibleActor|reo:requiresAuthorityOf|reo:refersToConcept|reo:refersToProperty|reo:usesInteraction|reo:performsAction|reo:expectsInteractionSource) ?e . ?c reo:appliesTo ?e } } ORDER BY ?c

question: For which requirements is a rule governing their responsible actor waived by an exception for the requirement's context?
query: PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX reo: <http://re-environment-onto.org/ontology#> PREFIX ex: <http://hospital.example.org#> PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#> SELECT DISTINCT ?r WHERE { ?r reo:assessedInContext ?x ; reo:hasResponsibleActor ?a . ?a reo:isSubjectTo ?c . ?c reo:hasException ?x . } ORDER BY ?r

question: Which goals are blocked, directly or through an ancestor goal, by an unvalidated uncertainty?
query: PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX reo: <http://re-environment-onto.org/ontology#> PREFIX ex: <http://hospital.example.org#> PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#> SELECT DISTINCT ?g WHERE { ?g reo:refines* ?b . ?u reo:blocks ?b ; reo:status "unvalidated" . ?g a/rdfs:subClassOf* reo:Goal . } ORDER BY ?g

question: Which requirements depend, through their seed lineage, on an unvalidated uncertainty?
query: PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX reo: <http://re-environment-onto.org/ontology#> PREFIX ex: <http://hospital.example.org#> PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#> SELECT DISTINCT ?r WHERE { ?r reo:hasSeedGoal ?s . ?s reo:refines* ?b . ?u reo:blocks ?b ; reo:status "unvalidated" . } ORDER BY ?r

question: Which requirements ask their responsible actor to perform an action outside its capabilities?
query: PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX reo: <http://re-environment-onto.org/ontology#> PREFIX ex: <http://hospital.example.org#> PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#> SELECT DISTINCT ?r ?act WHERE { ?r reo:hasResponsibleActor ?a ; reo:performsAction ?act . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?a reo:hasCapability ?act } } ORDER BY ?r

question: Which requirements use an interaction that exchanges none of the concepts they reference?
query: PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX reo: <http://re-environment-onto.org/ontology#> PREFIX ex: <http://hospital.example.org#> PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#> SELECT DISTINCT ?r WHERE { ?r reo:usesInteraction ?i ; reo:refersToConcept ?c0 . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?r reo:refersToConcept ?c . ?i reo:exchangesData ?c } } ORDER BY ?r

question: Is there a requirement whose expected interaction source differs from the interaction's actual source?
query: PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX reo: <http://re-environment-onto.org/ontology#> PREFIX ex: <http://hospital.example.org#> PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#> ASK { ?r reo:usesInteraction ?i ; reo:expectsInteractionSource ?s . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?i reo:hasSource ?s } }

question: Is there a requirement assessed in a context in which its responsible actor is neither active nor responsible for the seed lineage?
query: PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX reo: <http://re-environment-onto.org/ontology#> PREFIX ex: <http://hospital.example.org#> PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#> ASK { ?r reo:assessedInContext ?x ; reo:hasResponsibleActor ?a ; reo:hasSeedGoal ?s . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?x reo:hasActiveActor ?a } FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?s reo:refines* ?g . ?a reo:isResponsibleFor ?g } }

question: Is there a requirement that references a domain property not owned by any concept it references?
query: PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX reo: <http://re-environment-onto.org/ontology#> PREFIX ex: <http://hospital.example.org#> PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#> ASK { ?r reo:refersToProperty ?p . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?r reo:refersToConcept ?c . ?c reo:hasProperty ?p } }

question: Which goals have no requirement anchored in them?
query: PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX reo: <http://re-environment-onto.org/ontology#> PREFIX ex: <http://hospital.example.org#> PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#> SELECT ?g WHERE { ?g a/rdfs:subClassOf* reo:Goal . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?r reo:hasSeedGoal ?g } } ORDER BY ?g

question: Which requirements must be re-evaluated if the Physician changes (direct trace-based impact)?
query: PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX reo: <http://re-environment-onto.org/ontology#> PREFIX ex: <http://hospital.example.org#> PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#> SELECT DISTINCT ?r WHERE { ?rec reo:assesses ?req ; prov:wasGeneratedBy ?act . ?act reo:consulted ex:Physician . ?req reo:requirementId ?r . } ORDER BY ?r

question: Which records are conditional, and which uncertainty did their validation consult?
query: PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX reo: <http://re-environment-onto.org/ontology#> PREFIX ex: <http://hospital.example.org#> PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#> SELECT ?r ?u WHERE { ?rec reo:hasDecision reo:Conditional ; reo:assesses ?req ; prov:wasGeneratedBy ?act . ?req reo:requirementId ?r . ?act reo:consulted ?u . ?u a/rdfs:subClassOf* reo:Uncertainty . } ORDER BY ?r ?u

question: Which records consulted a constraint that names no validator, and what decision did they receive?
query: PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX reo: <http://re-environment-onto.org/ontology#> PREFIX ex: <http://hospital.example.org#> PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#> SELECT ?r ?c ?d WHERE { ?rec reo:assesses ?req ; reo:hasDecision ?d ; prov:wasGeneratedBy ?act . ?req reo:requirementId ?r . ?act reo:consulted ?c . ?c a/rdfs:subClassOf* reo:Constraint . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?c reo:validatorKey ?k } } ORDER BY ?r ?c

question: What decision did each requirement receive?
query: PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX reo: <http://re-environment-onto.org/ontology#> PREFIX ex: <http://hospital.example.org#> PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#> SELECT ?r ?d WHERE { ?rec reo:assesses ?req ; reo:hasDecision ?d . ?req reo:requirementId ?r . } ORDER BY ?r

question: Is there an accepted record whose validation consulted no element?
query: PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX reo: <http://re-environment-onto.org/ontology#> PREFIX ex: <http://hospital.example.org#> PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#> ASK { ?rec reo:hasDecision ?d ; prov:wasGeneratedBy ?act . FILTER(?d IN (reo:Accepted, reo:AcceptedWithReservations)) FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?act reo:consulted ?e } }

question: Which elements are affected by an uncertainty of high or critical impact, and by which uncertainty?
query: PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX reo: <http://re-environment-onto.org/ontology#> PREFIX ex: <http://hospital.example.org#> PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#> SELECT ?e ?u WHERE { ?u reo:affects ?e ; reo:impactLevel ?l . FILTER(?l IN ("high","critical")) } ORDER BY ?e ?u

question: Which invariants constrain the concepts related to Patient?
query: PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX reo: <http://re-environment-onto.org/ontology#> PREFIX ex: <http://hospital.example.org#> PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#> SELECT ?i WHERE { ex:D002_Patient reo:relatedTo ?c . ?c reo:hasInvariant ?i . } ORDER BY ?i

question: Is there a strategic goal declared as a leaf?
query: PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX reo: <http://re-environment-onto.org/ontology#> PREFIX ex: <http://hospital.example.org#> PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#> ASK { ?g a reo:StrategicGoal ; reo:refinementType "leaf" . }

question: Is there a data-flow interaction without a declared protocol?
query: PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX reo: <http://re-environment-onto.org/ontology#> PREFIX ex: <http://hospital.example.org#> PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#> ASK { ?i a reo:DataFlowInteraction . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?i reo:protocol ?p } }
